ns2:section.sectionText: If you are a degree-seeking student taking a mix of campus-based and online delivered courses during the summer term, you should register for the course section(s) noted as CB. Students enrolling in these sections will be charged the campus range tuition. Online lectures will be held on Tuesdays and Fridays from 9 AM to 10 AM. Optional discussions will follow the online lectures from 10 AM to 11 AM.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
